rows.TEXT: In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for her blood thirsts. It is said that she once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Known in his times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended his reign of terror. He is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to his will.

Okknor 
"Sire, something is very wicked in these lands. The heat was so great, we could barely approach the east."

Emry of Abrissel 
"Yes, I see the blood-stained sky hanging above the mountains. But what of the great pillars of smoke?"

Okknor 
"Steam, Milord. The demon fires creep quickly into the snow-covered keeps of the Mountain Clans. There is an immense power spreading across the kingdom. We've never seen the demons so strong."

Emry of Abrissel 
"And what of the Elves? Has there been any word?"

Okknor 
"No word nor sign of them. The Elves used to have another sacred triad of cities deep in the lands that are now aflame. How can one race survive so much suffering?"

Emry of Abrissel 
"The Elves are a patient and noble people. Their way of life has remained unchanged for thousands of years. In the grand scheme of things, their recent tragedies are but a passing nightmare that will fade over time."

Emry of Abrissel 
"Duchess! Do not be alarmed! We are not here for war! We are here to offer support against the invasion!"

Lady Ambrielle 
"I am already aware of your intentions, Emry. I was informed before you even set foot out of Delgrenere. I suppose I owe you gratitude, but do not think to sway me in my plans for the throne."

Emry of Abrissel 
"By the Highfather! Am I the only one who doesn't know what I am doing before I do it? We've no time to discuss the throne. We have a unified Empire right in front of us. We will do this with two rulers for now."

Lady Ambrielle 
"You would allow another to share your rule? I must say...I am impressed. Very well, then. You are welcome to stay in my castle, let us hope it still stands by the end of this nightmare."

Emry of Abrissel 
"I will send my scouts at once to investigate the madness in the east."

Lady Ambrielle 
"Emry, there is something you should know. I sent my spies to contact the Elves. They have suffered much more than you can imagine in the past weeks."

Emry of Abrissel 
"Yes, they seemed convinced that this mysterious Lachla'an could speak with their god. A sad thing that their messiah was slain. Crowley has been dealt with."

Lady Ambrielle 
"Lachla'an was slain, true...but there is more. I have complete faith in my spies, but what they tell me is hard to grasp. They claim Gallean himself appeared to defend his children against Mortis' evil."

Emry of Abrissel 
"So it is true? Their god has returned! We must make things right with the Elves."

Lady Ambrielle 
"Gallean did return, but his wrath upon the corpse army twisted nature into an abomination. His anger tainted the very forest he had created. The Elves no longer feel his protection."

Lady Ambrielle 
"We must make contact with my spies. They are trapped in the northwestern marshlands, pursued by the Demons. They can help us once we find them."

Verzillin Spy 
"It took you long enough to send support. We have convinced these Elves to assist us against the armies of Bethrezen. We should waste no time..."

Nebiros 
"What is this stench of righteousness that fouls the air? Humans and Elves! Don't you know you've already lost?"

Emry of Abrissel 
"You are large, beast, but why should we cower before one demon? The Empire has removed far fouler of your kind from these lands!"

Nebiros 
"Fools! Can you not see what is before you? I draw my power from the very bowels of Hell! I spread Bethrezen's plague to engulf your pathetic cities!"

Lady Ambrielle 
"Did you hear? This creature is the source of the plague. Destroy it."

Nebiros 
"You may have defeated me, bu..."

Emry of Abrissel 
"Slay the Demon! I tire of its filthy tongue. This is a victory not only for the Empire, but for all of Nevendaar. None could escape the fiery Plague. Nebiros was but one of Bethrezen's minions. Dwarves, Elves, we would all be engulfed!

Emry of Abrissel 
"Princess Illumielle. Your people are free now! Come out of hiding! I knew you were under Ambrielle's protection."

Lady Ambrielle 
"Well. It seems not all my secrets are as well kept as I thought. I will forgive you for this one, dear Emry"

Illumielle 
"The lands are cooling! There is hope for our forests. I am grateful, Humans. Now I  return to my people, for they are scattered. Perhaps one day we will fight side by side again. Perhaps one day there will be no need for fighting at all."

Emry of Abrissel 
"Farewell, noble children of Gallean. May you rebuild and return to your forests. And while we are discussing rebirth, we still have a small matter to discuss ourselves, do we not, Duchess?"

Lady Ambrielle 
"We work well together, Emry. I am sure we could come to a reasonable agreement. Let us discuss this further...over dinner."

Emry of Abrissel 
"Yes!  A grand banquet! A woman who aims directly for my heart! I think you and I will do just fine, Ambrielle."

Natell 
"At least the Clans seem to be fighting the heretics as well. We may not be working together, but their efforts certainly show."

Dresdon 
"Praise the Highfather! We finally have our garrison back. How it pains me to see it so wrecked. It will be some time before it is usable again, and we haven't the resources to spare repairing it now."

Natell 
"It seems as though the Undead are lurking about. The evil that the plague is spreading must be attracting all types of dark forces..."

Zera 
"A library! Wonderful! See all the books we have found here! This will certainly help us with our war!"

Emry of Abrissel 
"People of Point Hope, I offer you freedom. Under my banner, the Empire will prosper! Support me and your troubled days will be but a memory!"

Captain Fellweather 
"Why should we trust you? Uther had such promises and they were nothing but lies!"

Emry of Abrissel 
"I am no demon. I am a man, as true as you and your brothers. See my men - do you see fear in their eyes? Do you see malice in mine? No, they do not follow me out of fear. It is out of respect. Trust in us, you will not regret it."

Captain Fellweather 
"Perhaps you do tell the truth. We will help you in your quest for now, but you will have to earn our loyalty."

Zera 
"How deeply disturbing! We must consecrate this ground!"

Dresdon 
"Look! That scorched corpse holds a potion to its skull! Whatever he was trying to drink, he took too long! I will pry it from his fingers..."

Medusa 
"What do you want, Humansss? The Fireskinsss are eassst of here. Leave usss, we do not have what you want!"
Okknor"The Dwarves favor these guard towers, but they haven't done them any good, have they?"

Okknor 
"Greenskins burned down this humble shop, there is no doubt about it. Savages!"

Zera 
"The stench of Undead rot is nearly unbearable. Must we remain here?"

Dresdon 
"I think we've gone the wrong way - we've found a plague, but not one of demonic origin. I only see rotten carcasses and dead trees..."

Dresdon 
"There was a great battle in this little village, that much is obvious. See the fractured walls and unburied corpses? The villagers must have erected these walls in haste as the demons charged down the mountains."

Dresdon 
"We do the Dwarves a favor by removing the Orcs. Do you suppose they will try to set up their own fort here?"

Zera 
"Great evil has been called up from the ground! These holes glow with the fires of Hell at their heart."

Zera 
"Great evil has been called up from the ground! These holes glow with the fires of Hell at their heart."

Knight 
"Our beautiful city Confidence, how we have missed her shining walls and gleaming bells. The people of the city are now safe again."

Zera 
"Yes, the Dwarves have been pushed westward into our lands by the demonic plague. Their frontiers grow smaller by the day. I pity them."

Dresdon 
"This city stinks of Trolls. It will take decades to clean."

Jillins 
"The Clans haven't held this city for very long, Milord. It is clear that these walls were constructed by Greenskins. Our engineers will do what they can to repair the damage, but the city is in shambles."

Zera 
"We are getting closer to the source of the evil, Milord. It is spreading from the North, according to the accounts we found in runic script. This city must have belonged to the Clans recently. "

Natell 
"The devastation here is just terrible, Milord. We are standing in an old Elven city. It hardly resembles one anymore."

Natell 
"These scrolls chronicle the fate of Elgrid the Tamer, an Elven lord that used to dwell here. The Plague destroyed Elgrid's creatures and the Demons drove him from his home."

Dresdon 
"All right men. You know the procedure when we deal with Dopplegangers. Mullens, what is your eldest daughter's name?"

Dresdon 
"Semble, what is your eldest daughter's name?"

Dresdon 
"Damn. Take Semble to the nearest tree and hang him."

Okknor 
"The very ocean boils here. I've never seen anything like this."

Natell 
"Nevendaar is breaking away as Bethrezen scars the land. This is madness! We must hurry!"

Dresdon 
"Apparently this was the old Capital of the Demons. Now that they've moved into Elven territory, it lies in ruin. It is still overrun with dangerous demonic creatures."

Come in, have some ale, rest your weary feet!
A free skull with every purchase.
All the power that Bethrezen has to offer is at your fingertips... for a price...
The power of the Earth is at your disposal.
True defenders of the realm will you become.
I will train your units for a price.
The toughest of the tough, all for a price.
All types of tamed monsters can be acquired here!
I don't have much, but it should be enough.
Do not trouble me with your petty requests.
